articles.title_en: Czech military must prepare for prolonged war, but lacks the funding, says former army chief
articles.lead_en: The Czech government is due to discuss a new military development strategy looking ahead to 2040, which identifies Russia as a major security threat and calls for substantial improvements in the country's defence capabilities. But former chief of the Czech general staff Jiří Šedivý (now CEVRO University) warns that planned funding will not be sufficient to meet those ambitions.
